title: Collective mechanical modes in a minimal ion-channel gate model: code and data
description:
Code and data for the paper Collective Mechanical Modes in a Minimal Model of Ion Channel Gate Dynamics (G. Frenkel, L. Mourokh, Y. Ben-Abu; Computational and Structural Biotechnology Journal, 2026). The repository contains the Jupyter notebook of the two-dimensional rod-and-spring model of a K2P channel gate (equations of motion, normal modes, eigenvalues and eigenvectors), the Python scripts for the zero-mode analysis, thermal amplitudes, damping estimates, sensitivity analysis and Langevin check, and the supplementary figures, animations and tables.

Code: MIT license. Figures, animations and supplementary data: CC BY 4.0 (see supplementary/LICENSE.md).
